channel.title: The New Yorker — Reporting
channel.description: Latest reporting from The New Yorker

item.title: The American Art of Blowing Stuff Up
item.description: Fireworks by Grucci has been in the pyrotechnics business for six generations.

item.title: The Man Who Was Kidnapped Twice
item.description: Thousands of people in Nigeria have been held for ransom by bandit groups. One professor escaped his captors—only to be abducted again.

item.title: The Delusions of John Roberts
item.description: The Chief Justice insists that his Supreme Court isn’t biased even as it keeps making dramatic leaps rightward.

item.title: Inside Russia’s New Gulag
item.description: Human-rights groups estimate that more than ten thousand Ukrainian civilians have disappeared into the Russian prison system. This is the story of one cell.

item.title: Are You a Human?
item.description: From branding irons to iris scans, the ancient business of proving who you are has never been stranger—or more lucrative.

item.title: The Doulas Who Help Us Die
item.description: In an aging America, thousands of people have adopted a new vocation: supporting others as they confront the end of life.

item.title: The Children a Scientist Took Home
item.description: Carleton Gajdusek won the Nobel Prize for his work on a disease in Papua New Guinea. But his biggest experiment was on the children he took back to the U.S.

item.title: The End of the European Summer
item.description: As extreme heat overwhelms the Continent’s great cities, they are racing to transform themselves for a climate that they were never built to withstand.

item.title: The Big, Dumb, Gluttonous Fun of America’s Semiquincentennial
item.description: In D.C. and the Dakotas, at rodeos and powwows, celebrating the country means taking in pride and disappointment and fellow-feeling.

item.title: How Far Will the Trump Administration Go to Deport Mahmoud Khalil?
item.description: Khalil protested Israel as a student at Columbia. Now he’s on the verge of being kicked out of the country.
